user.title: Connect to Zenbi
user.description: Enter the login you use at app.zenbi.dk. This is an unofficial integration against Zenbi's private API — see the repository README before using it.

children.title: Name your children
children.description: These class codes were found in your account's schedule ({codes}). Optionally give each one a friendly name (e.g. "4A" → "Emma") — leave any blank to just use the raw class code.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Zenbi. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Zenbi account is already configured.

children.title: Name your children
children.description: Update the friendly name shown for each class code. Leave blank to use the raw class code.

directory_cache.title: Directory cache (advanced, off by default)
directory_cache.description: The zenbi.search_people service already looks up the school directory live, on demand, and keeps nothing afterwards — that's the supported way to use this. Turning this on instead adds a sensor that polls and stores the *entire* school family directory (names, addresses, phone numbers, parent/child links) as standing sensor state, refreshed on a timer, whether you look at it or not. See the README's "Why the directory search is a service, not a sensor" section before enabling this. Leave off unless you specifically want a cached/standing copy and accept that tradeoff.

search_people.name: Search people
search_people.description: Live, on-demand lookup against Zenbi's school directory — searches by name and returns matching student(s)/parent(s) plus their linked family relations. Not cached.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Zenbi config entry to search under.

query.name: Query
query.description: Name (or part of a name) to search for. At least 2 characters.
